nombre: Pollo piri-piri con ensalada de repollo
pasos: Whizz together all of the marinade ingredients in a small food processor. Rub the marinade onto the chicken and leave for 1 hour at room temperature.
Heat the oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Put the chicken in a roasting tray and cook for 1 hour 20 minutes.
Rest under loose foil for 20 minutes. While the chicken is resting, mix together the slaw ingredients and season.
Serve the chicken with slaw, fries and condiments.
